name: data-table
title: Data Table
description: A sortable table with real table markup. Click a heading to sort ascending, descending, then back to the original order. Numbers sort as numbers.

props.name: columns
props.description: The columns, each with a key, header, optional align, sortable flag and render function.

props.name: getRowId
props.description: A stable id for each row. Defaults to the row's index.

props.name: sort
props.description: Controlled sort, as a column key and a direction.

props.name: defaultSort
props.description: Initial sort when you do not control it.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called when the reader changes the sort.

props.name: caption
props.description: Visible caption, also the table's accessible name.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
